sentences.text: The present application is filed for condonation of delay of 663 days in filing of the main matter.

sentences.text: The affidavit is taken on record.
It is further contended that because of scarcity of amount, the applicants could not pay necessary Court fees and expenses involved in filing the first appeal.

It is further contended that the concerned learned advocate sent affidavit for condonation of delay on 24.8.2023 and the said affidavit came to be executed before the Notary by the applicant on 22.3.2024.
Thereafter, the present application was filed for condonation of delay.

It is submitted that after the receipt of the affidavit dated 22.3.2024, learned advocate was waiting for Vakalatnama to be sent by applicants and when the Vakalatnama was received by the learned advocate for the applicant, the present application was presented on 23.1.2025.

It is submitted that in the vehicular accident, the husband of claimant No.1 has expired and claimants being the widow and children of deceased are facing financial crisis and they are coming from tribal area, delay was caused.

It is further contended that the applicant shall not claim any interest on enhanced amount, if any, for the delayed period and they shall waive their right of claiming interest for such delayed period.

C/CA/629/2025 ORDER  
 3.
Learned advocate for the responden company has no objection if the delay is condoned.

4. Having considered the submissions of learned advocates for the respective parties and on perusal of the application, it appears that the affidavit in support of the application was executed on 22.3.2024, however, the application for condonation of delay is presented on 23.1.2025.

It also appears that no explanation is forthcoming as to how after the affidavit was sworn in the year 2024,
the application for condonation of delay was not presented immediately thereafter.

The explanation which is given by learned advocate for the applicant for such gap is that the Vakalatnama was not received alongwith the affidavit and the same was received in the month of January, 2025.
Thereafter, the application was presented.
Such explanation though sounds attractive but has no force because on perusal of Vakalatnama of the applicant, the date is mentioned as 22.3.2024.
Further so far as question of arranging funds are concerned, as per the additional affidavit, they have received compensation on 27.9.2023.

Therefore, there is no reason of scarcity of funds also Madhuben Wd/O Narendrasinh vs Himmatsinh Dhirsinh Baria on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54277642/

5. While deciding the application for condonation of delay, the Court has to be lenient and the explanation which has been given by the applicants for condonation of delay is to be viewed in a liberal manner.

The First Appeal is arising out of claim compensation and the proceedings under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 being a benevolent legislation, a lenient view is required to be adopted while considering the explanation.

6. In the present case, the explanation which is forthcoming is not genuine but just with a view to see that the claimants are not deprived off their rights to claim more compensation, by taking a lenient view, delay is condoned subject to cost of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees five thousand only) to be deposited by the claimants before the Secretary, Gujarat High Court Legal Services Committee on or before 23.4.2025.

entities.text: Gujarat High Court Legal Services Committee
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further directed that considering the averments made in the application and looking to the conduct of the claimants, they are not entitled to any interest for delayed period.

C/CA/629/2025 ORDER DATED: 0  
7. In view of above, delay is condoned on two conditions; (1) applicants shall deposit cost of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees five thousand only) to be deposited by the claimants before the Secretary,
Gujarat High Court Legal Services Committee on or before 23.4.2025 and (2) the applicants /
claimants shall not be entitled to interest for the delayed period on the enhanced amount, if it is granted in favour of the claimants.
8. This application is allowed in above terms.
